brief.name: Optical budget balance
brief.purpose: Source, loss components and receiver interval arranged left to right without baked numbers
brief.learningIntent: O06 / T04/T05/T15; dBm level and dB difference stay distinct
brief.plannedMethod: Actual OpenAI base imagery with preserved original output; all exact labels/values in semantic UI, with manual diagrams/edits truthfully recorded

binding.alt: A source capsule, two passive components and a receiver gauge are arranged in order on a brass bench.
binding.caption: Work left to right. In this fictional example, −3 dBm transmit minus 8 dB total loss gives −11 dBm received. Above −14 dBm sensitivity that leaves 3 dB reserve. Check the separate −1 dBm maximum and the supplied compatibility conditions.

conversion: Scale the full uncropped frame with Lanczos and encode RGB WebP at quality 88, method 6. No retouching or labels in the derivative.
